svg.title: TRACE ESP32-S3 Sensor Front-End Schematic
svg.desc: Engineering schematic for LDR, FSR 402 and piezo vibration sensor connections to ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1.
svg.text: AMBIENT LIGHT · THIN-FILM PRESSURE · VIBRATION ENVELOPE
GPIO4 / GPIO5 / GPIO6 avoid USB D-/D+
R6 limits current; D1 rectifies; C3/R7
hold the peak; D2 clamps to the 3V3
LDR and FSR thresholds must be learned
from the installed enclosure and real
